creative_improvements.idea: bb-squeeze+ regime-aware confidence dampener (NOT hard block)
creative_improvements.rationale: bb-squeeze+ works in NORMAL (+$0.25/18T 66.7%WR) but bleeds in HIGH (-$0.26/40T) and EXTREME (-$0.25/13T). Rather than blocking regimes (which kills winners), dampen confidence in HIGH/EXTREME so fewer low-quality entries fire. Meta-RSI 60-70 is the sweet spot (75%WR +$0.44) — combine regime + RSI for confidence scoring.
creative_improvements.expected_impact: Reduce HIGH/EXTREME bleed by ~50% while preserving NORMAL winners
